messages.author: 0047b623f2d48d40
messages.subject: Extracting values from LGCP
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to plot nest density and have been following the example here closely: https://inlabru-org.github.io/inlabru/articles/web/2d_lgcp_sf.html

Would it be possible to provide some example code to illustrate how to extract the value for maximum density of nests on the linear predictor scale?
Thanks!

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Extracting values from LGCP
parts:
If you just want a point estimate of the maximum density, then max(pred$mean) would give you that, from a predict call with predictor formula
  ~ exp(the expression for the linear predictor)
I think the vignette already includes such a predict call.

If you want the posterior distribution of the maximum, then using generate() with expression
  ~ max(exp(…))
will give you samples from it.  Using the same formula with predict() will give you summary statistics (posterior mean, std.dev, and some quantiles).

Finn
